nodes.name: Read Mock Marketing Data
nodes.notes: Point this at your own copy of automation/mock-marketing-data-template.csv (104 rows / 26 days) imported into Google Sheets. See SETUP_GUIDE.md.

nodes.name: Build Fallback Narrative
nodes.notes: Always runs before Gemini is even called — guarantees a usable summary + 3 actions with zero external dependency.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [ { parts: [ { text: `Write a 2-3 sentence CEO-style executive summary of yesterday's marketing performance, direct and confident tone, no bullet points, no headings. Metrics: spend ₹${$json.spend}, revenue ₹${$json.revenue}, blended ROAS ${$json.roas}x (${$json.deltas.roas}% vs the day before), ${$json.leads} leads, budget pacing at ${$json.budget_pacing_pct}% of the month-to-date plan. Anomalies: ${$json.anomalies.length ? $json.anomalies.map(a => a.channel + ' at ' + a.roas + 'x').join('; ') : 'none detected'}.` } ] } ], generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 220 } }) }}

nodes.name: Ask Gemini for AI Narrative
nodes.notes: Free tier — requires a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey), no payment method needed. Requires an HTTP Query Auth credential named 'Gemini API' with query param name 'key' = your Gemini API key.

nodes.name: Build Email HTML
nodes.notes: The chart image is fetched live from quickchart.io (free, no key) when the recipient opens the email — mention this in SETUP_GUIDE.

nodes.name: Send Morning Brief Email
nodes.notes: Confirm the Email Type field shows 'HTML' after import — set it manually if the import doesn't carry it over cleanly.

meta.description: MarkOS AI Module 11 (Reporting & Dashboard Engine) — daily automated morning brief. Pulls sample marketing data (104 rows / 26 days), computes KPI deltas and an 8-day trend, asks Gemini's free-tier API for an executive summary (falling back to a rule-based one if that call fails), and emails a CEO-style HTML infographic with an embedded chart.
